cfg.autoStart: Start the hub when the editor opens.
cfg.bootstrap: Private mode: your own bootstrap nodes "host:port".
cfg.dhtPort: UDP port of the hub in lan mode.
cfg.excludedSessions: Sessions hidden from the team even if their project is shared. Managed from the panel.
cfg.language: Language of the Session Hub interface and messages.
cfg.listSince: Which sessions are listed in the panel.
cfg.name: Your name as your team will see it (signed with your key).
cfg.network: How the team's hubs connect to each other (always encrypted and authenticated).
cfg.network.enum0: Local network: the hubs themselves form the network; no internet needed.
cfg.network.enum1: Your own bootstrap nodes (sessionHub.bootstrap): controlled remote or VPN.
cfg.network.enum2: Public HyperDHT network: remote with zero setup.
cfg.nodePath: Empty = use the editor runtime (recommended). Or a path to Node 22.5 or later.
cfg.notifyReads: Notify when a teammate reads your sessions (who, which session, project and tool).
cfg.notifyUpdates: Notify when a teammate progresses on a session.
cfg.paused: Global pause: while active, nobody on the team sees your sessions.
cfg.peers: Extra "host:port" (UDP) addresses of teammates, in case the network doesn't find them.
cfg.port: HTTP port of the local API (extension, MCP, viewer).
cfg.redactExtra: Extra regular expressions to hide (client names, etc.).
cfg.relay: Public key of a blind relay (printed by npm run infra). Used only when a direct connection isn't possible; it can't read anything.
cfg.sharedProjects: Projects whose sessions you share. Use the 'Share this project' command.
cfg.sharedProjects.allow: Who sees it: ["*"] = whole team, or people's public keys.
cmd.blockMember: Block / unblock a person (just for me)
cmd.toggleSessionVisibility: Hide / show session to the team
ext.description: Your team and its AI, connected: share Claude Code and Cursor sessions, message teammates, and keep a local backup even after the tool deletes them. Peer-to-peer, encrypted, signed identities, MCP built in.
view.welcome:
Share your Claude Code and Cursor sessions with your team.
[Create team](command:sessionHub.createTeam)
[Join with an invitation](command:sessionHub.joinTeam)
Already have a team: [Start hub](command:sessionHub.start) · [Open panel](command:sessionHub.openDashboard) · [Diagnostics](command:sessionHub.doctor)
cmd.approveMessage: Let my AI read the message
cfg.inboundMessages: Messages from teammates. They always arrive signed and verified and never run anything.
cfg.inboundMessages.enum0: Hold: they wait until you approve them or pass them to your AI (recommended)
cfg.inboundMessages.enum1: Accept: your AI can read them right away with check_inbox
cfg.notifyMessages: Notify when a teammate sends you a message.
cfg.aiChat: Where "Pass to my AI" leaves the message. It is always typed in, never sent: you review it and press Send.
cfg.aiChat.enum0: Automatic: the session the message was for, the chat in the active tab, or the last one you chose
cfg.aiChat.enum1: Claude Code (your session in this project, or a new one)
cfg.aiChat.enum2: The editor's chat (Copilot in VS Code, Cursor's chat in Cursor)
cmd.purgeOwnBackup: Delete from my backup what no longer exists
cfg.backupOwnSessions: Back up your shared sessions locally. They stay available (for you and whoever you share with) even if Claude Code or Cursor delete them.
cfg.backupRetentionDays: Days to keep sessions that only exist in your backup (0 = no limit).
cfg.keepTeamCopies: Keep local copies of your teammates' sessions to read them offline. Only while you still have access: if they hide or stop sharing them, the copy is deleted.
cfg.teamCopiesRetentionDays: Copies the owner does not confirm within this many days are deleted (0 = no limit).
cfg.allowTeamCopies: Allow your teammates to keep copies of your sessions. If you turn it off, their copies are deleted the next time they connect.
cfg.backupMaxMB: Maximum space for backup and copies (MB). Oldest items that only exist in the backup are deleted first.
cfg.conversationTurns: Automatic conversations: maximum messages from each side.
